Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the SEO Expert position at WPP Media. With over two years of hands-on experience in SEO, GEO, and content strategy, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your Total Search Activation team.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites. I have also developed my own project, mirook.com, where I implemented structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. My experience includes using tools like Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, GA4, and Semrush, and I am eager to deepen my knowledge of SEA.

I am fluent in English and Turkish, with a B1 level in Dutch, and I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp. I am known for my curiosity, collaborative mindset, and ability to connect search performance to broader business impact.

I would love to discuss how my skills can contribute to WPP Media's innovative search offerings. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the SEO Expert position at WPP Media. With over two years of hands-on experience in SEO, GEO, and content strategy, I am drawn to WPP Media's pioneering approach to search and its commitment to delivering measurable business impact for world-class brands.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and write keyword-targeted content that grows organic traffic. I also build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, and I track performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console. This hands-on experience has taught me that SEO is not just about rankings but about connecting search performance to brand sentiment, leads, and sales.

Beyond my client work, I developed mirook.com, a project where I implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema), entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. I ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score. This project reflects my curiosity and commitment to continuous learning in the rapidly evolving search landscape.

I am particularly interested in developing my knowledge of SEA and contributing to Total Search projects. I am comfortable collaborating with specialists and seeking input when needed, and I take ownership of my work, setting clear expectations and following through.

I speak English and Turkish, with a B1 level in Dutch, and I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp. I would welcome the opportunity to bring my technical expertise and collaborative mindset to WPP Media's Total Search Activation team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
